title: Testing: feature vs unit, factories, mocking, Pest

preview.what: Testing that pays for itself: feature vs unit, factories, mocking, Pest.
preview.picture: A feature test is a customer walking through the restaurant; a unit test is checking one knife is sharp. Factories are the prop department; mocks are stand-in actors for the payment API.
preview.why: Being able to say what you would NOT test is the senior part.
preview.bn: Feature test = customer পুরো restaurant হেঁটে দেখে, unit test = একটা ছুরি ধার কিনা; mock = বদলি অভিনেতা।
